subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Identificar e discutir o propósito do uso de recursos de persuasão (cores, imagens, escolha de palavras, jogo de palavras, tamanho de letras) em textos publicitários e de propaganda, como elementos de convencimento.

components.description_pt: Identificar dispositivos persuasivos como cores, imagens e escolha de palavras em textos publicitários
components.description_en: Identify persuasive devices such as colors, images, and word choice in advertising texts
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how an author's word choice and emphasis convey their purpose in a text

components.description_pt: Explicar a função persuasiva do tamanho de fonte e jogos de palavras em materiais promocionais
components.description_en: Explain the persuasive function of font size and wordplay in promotional materials
components.cc_component_description: Explain the function of a specific section of text in building the author's overall argument

components.description_pt: Discutir como elementos visuais e linguísticos específicos são usados para persuadir audiências em anúncios
components.description_en: Discuss how specific visual and linguistic elements are used to persuade audiences in advertisements
components.cc_component_description: Analyze a speaker's use of rhetorical strategies to persuade an audience

cc_matches.description: Determine an author's point of view or purpose in a text and explain how it is conveyed in the text.
Analyze in detail how an author's ideas or claims are developed and refined by particular sentences, paragraphs, or larger portions of a text (e.g., a section or chapter).
Evaluate a speaker's point of view, reasoning, and use of evidence and rhetoric, identifying any fallacious reasoning or exaggerated or distorted evidence.
